Note.title: Note
Note.description: A note authored by the user.

content.description: The text content of the note.

category.description: The category classification (e.g. Personal, Work, Ideas, Study, General).

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns the note.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when note was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when note was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Private notes belonging to an authenticated user.
